studies.headline: Accipiter melanoleucus occupies more of the region than it did thirty years ago.
studies.value: +0.106 in the probability a cell is occupied
studies.detail: Occupancy 0.443 in 1987-1991 against 0.549 in 2008-2012, over 496 quarter-degree cells atlassed at least 20 times in both epochs. Detection was estimated separately in each epoch at 0.045 and 0.072.
studies.caveat: Two atlases thirty years apart, so this is a before and after and not a trend: nothing here is per decade. South Africa, Lesotho and Eswatini only, and only where volunteers atlassed twice. Nothing here says why.
